Egg The alleles of unlinked genes are either on separate chromosomes (such as d and e ) or so far apart on the same chromosome ( c and f ) that they assort independently. Genes on the same chromo- some whose alleles are so close together that they do not assort independently (such as a , b , and c ) are said to be genetically linked. Sperm P generation gametes This F 1 cell has 2 n = 6 chromo- somes and is heterozygous for all six genes shown ( AaBbCcDdEeFf ). Red = maternal; blue = paternal. Each chromosome has hundreds or thousands of genes. Four ( A, B, C, F ) are shown on this one. C BA D E F c ba d e f C B A D E F c b a d e f
